sitemap.format.note: A standard XML sitemap in UTF-8. The sitemap protocol is the source; Bing's own page was not read.

sitemap.max_urls.note: The protocol allows 50,000 URLs per file. News Distribution keeps its own file to 1,000.

sitemap.lastmod.note: An accurate last-modified time on every URL. Whether Bing relies on it was not confirmed.

sitemap.robots.note: A Sitemap line in robots.txt is part of the sitemap protocol. It is off until the person turns it on.

sitemap.language.note: Each sitemap holds only articles of its own language.

fetch.schedule.source: Design review log, Channel-bing: the claim could not be confirmed
fetch.schedule.note: Bing reads a new sitemap on its own schedule, usually soon after it is submitted. This could not be confirmed, so the copy says usually.

verify.methods.note: Bing offers an XML file, a meta tag or a CNAME record. Read through a third-party summary.
